references.text: Solomon had many foreign wives who turned his heart away from the Lord, a direct fulfillment of the warning in Deuteronomy 17:17
Solomon gathered enormous amounts of gold and silver, which broke the prohibition against kings accumulating much silver and gold
David took several concubines and wives in Jerusalem, a practice that Deuteronomy warned kings against
God warns against taking Canaanite women as wives because they will lead to idolatry, the same principle behind the warning in Deuteronomy
Job declares that he has not set his trust on gold or silver, in line with the principle of not accumulating wealth
Nehemiah rebukes the Israelites for taking foreign wives and mentions Solomon's sin as a warning, linked to Deuteronomy 17:17
Paul warns against love of money as a root of all kinds of evil, consistent with the warning against accumulating wealth
Jesus teaches not to store up treasures on earth, a principle that reflects the warning against gathering gold and silver
